queries.name: clinicPatients
queries.sourceSql:
-- A sealed row reads NULL in given_names; the aliased marker names its key.
SELECT p.id, p.given_names, p.ward, p._sync_sealed_key AS sealed_key
FROM patients AS p
WHERE p.clinic_id = :clinicId
ORDER BY p.id

ORDER BY p.id

queries.name: patientDisplay

queries.name: readablePatients
queries.sourceSql:
select patients.id, patients.given_names AS "givenNames" from patients
  where patients.clinic_id = :clinicId and patients._sync_sealed_key is null
  order by patients.id
